spanish: ¿Y en qué será conocido entonces que hallé favor en tus ojos, yo y tu pueblo? ¿No en tu andar con nosotros? Y seremos distinguidos yo y tu pueblo de todo el pueblo que sobre la faz del suelo.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'desde' with 'de' after 'seremos distinguidos': with the niphal here, מִן marks the set the speakers are set apart from, not a point of origin, and Spanish 'desde' wrongly implies a starting point.
Added the definite article before 'faz' ('la faz del suelo') because the construct chain פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה is definite through הָאֲדָמָה; the draft's bare 'faz' had dropped that definiteness.
